Package backend

Class DatabaseManagerH2

java.lang.Object
backend.DatabaseManagerH2
public class DatabaseManagerH2 extends Object
The class that enables communication between the application and the H2 database.

    • addToProductTable

      public void addToProductTable(String name, String description, String brand, double price, int stock, String imagePath, String colors, double discount)
      Adds the products to the database
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the product.
      description - The description of the product.
      brand - The brand of the product.
      price - The price of the product.
      stock - The initial stock of the product.
      imagePath - A path to a png file, with low resolution and weighing less than 50ko, with an image of the product.
      colors - A string representing the colors of the products, separated by commas or blank spaces.
      discount - A value between 0 and 1 indicating the proportion of the price that is reduced (example : 0,2 for 20% discount).

    • addToProductTable

      public int addToProductTable(String name, String description, String brand, double price, int stock, File imageFile, String colors, double discount)
      Adds the products to the database. Is used for drag and dropped files that are not present in the repository and whose paths are unknown.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the product.
      description - The description of the product.
      brand - The brand of the product.
      price - The price of the product.
      stock - The initial stock of the product.
      imageFile - A png file, with low resolution and weighing less than 50ko, representing the product.
      colors - A string representing the colors of the products, separated by commas or blank spaces.
      discount - A value between 0 and 1 indicating the proportion of the price that is reduced (example : 0,2 for 20% discount).
      Returns:
      The primary key generated during the insertion that identifies the product.

    • launchGlobalDiscount

      public void launchGlobalDiscount(Map<Integer,String> colors, double priceMin, double priceMax, double discount, String[] brands)
      Launches a discount of specified value for all products matching the given criteria in the database.
      Parameters:
      colors - A map containing as entries the identifier of the color and as values their names. If the product matches one of these colors, it satisfies this filter.
      priceMin - The minimum price for the product (in €).
      priceMax - The maximum price for the product (in €).
      discount - The value of the discount (between 0 and 1 : 0 corresponds to no discount and 1 to a 100% discount).
      brands - The brands targeted by the discount, separated by commas or blank spaces. An empty string means all brands are selected.

    • checkIfCustomerBecomesPremium

      public boolean checkIfCustomerBecomesPremium()
      Checks if the customer becomes a premium member after uploading an achievement. After 5 achievements, a customer becomes premium unless the administrator removed their status.
      Returns:
      True if the customer becomes a premium member and false if they are already a premium member, or don't have enough achievements, or have had their status removed.
